articles.title: Nike CEO Buys $1 Million of Stock as Insiders Bet on a Turnaround
articles.content: Nike stock slumped in 2025 as it continued a multiyear downturn. A Form 4 filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission shows President and CEO Elliott Hill bought 16,388 shares of the sportswear company for about $61.10 apiece on Dec. 29. The transaction boosted his direct holdings to 241,587 Class B shares, valued at nearly $14.8 million based on Tuesday’s closing price of $61.19.
